title: Certified Public Relations Professional
overview: This course provides a comprehensive, step-by-step approach to Public Relations (PR) planning and management. By following these established methods, PR professionals will achieve measurable results that can be reported to senior management, directly contributing to the organization’s success by enhancing its reputation and fostering strong relationships. Participants will learn the fundamental aspects of PR and their significance in understanding organizational reputation and relationships. Given the often challenging and complex nature of PR situations, this course will equip you with the skills needed to present practical and achievable plans that inspire management confidence.
audience: This course is designed for managers, supervisors, and officers with experience in public relations. It is also beneficial for key personnel who interact with internal or external publics, particularly in areas such as personnel, marketing, sales, training, and administration.
methodology: The workshop is interactive and participatory, incorporating a variety of learning tools to help participants operate effectively in a multifunctional environment. The course includes presentations, role-playing, group exercises, experience sharing during roundtable discussions, and team exercises with group debriefs.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify the functions of public relations in a dynamic environment
Plan and organize a PR program by familiarizing themselves with the core functions of a PR professional
Practice key communication skills and techniques essential for their PR roles
Apply their knowledge to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders
Articulate the PR professional's role in supporting the organization’s image and reputation through proficient verbal and written communication
Prepare for and conduct a press conference
